about_the_game:
The pen is in your hands.

Write your own campaign promises in your own words. Literally. Then, watch as they are assessed based on a myriad of factors including historical context, district characteristics, and current events. Your ability to craft compelling and appropriate policies is key to gaining public support.

Engaging Turn-Based Gameplay

Spend your days wisely, balancing between gathering intelligence on district events, spreading fake news, and sabotaging your competitors.

Victory Through Strategy and Insight

As you progress through the game, you will refine your strategies based on the evolving political landscape. The ultimate goal is to win the final presidential election by securing the highest vote count across all districts.

Dive into the world of ELHKIA, where your political creativity (and a bit of English composition) is put to the test. Can you navigate through the complexities of city-state politics and emerge victorious? Your campaign starts now.
